'''Jim Boyd''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 AugustaCon Constructed (Day 1)]] in October 2000 with X-wing swarm Hyper Escape with Draw Their Fire, according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1379">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-jabronicon-2000-pauld1379/ jabronicon-2000-paul], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-jabronicon-2000-pauld1379/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
